annotations.title: Mark flagged messages right or wrong

description: Records a reviewer verdict on flagged messages: TP (rightly flagged), FP (wrongly flagged) or null (clear the verdict). The same verdicts as the console's review queue. Up to 100 messages per call, by message_id from list_flagged_messages. Needs owner, admin or editor access.

verdict.description: TP, FP, or null to clear.

name: review_flagged_messages
